newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian textile exports seen rising in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian textile exports seen rising in 1997.

text.p: The Indonesia Textile Association said on Monday the country's exports of textiles and textile products were expected to rise to more than $7 billion in 1997 from an estimated $6.8 billion last year.
Indonesia's textile and textile-product exports were worth $6.0 billion in 1995.

"Our textile products are facing many challenges, both domestically and abroad. There are levies in the regions (in Indonesia) that burdened our products," association Secretary-General Benny Soetrisno told reporters after a meeting with President Suharto.
The association said in a statement that Indonesian textiles and textile products faced strong competition from abroad.
"Many buyers of Indonesian textiles and products are turning to countries such as Bangladesh, Vietnam and Turkey for their supplies," the statement said.
